review_unit: Mouse gene with study-specific species and experimental context
negative_evidence_policy: Negative and inconclusive results retained explicitly
functional_risk_policy: Distinguish published deleterious perturbation from potential physiological interaction risks
review_queue_policy: Search navigation only; no candidate exclusion or final ranking
limitations: Literature review is targeted rather than systematic
Unreviewed receptors remain eligible for assessment
Antibody uptake does not establish peptide uptake
Endocytosis does not establish abluminal cargo release
Viral-vector transport does not establish standalone peptide transport
Mouse evidence is not automatically transferred to human orthologues
Negative results apply to the investigated ligand and model
Physiological risk hypotheses require experimental confirmation
